thread:
alex: Quick sync — RFC review planning for next Wed 09:00 PT. Need to slot authors and tighten the agenda. Can folks reply with availability and whether they need 10 / 20 / 30 min? Also nudge for pre-reads.
jamal: I can do 09:00 PT. I have one ~25min slot (deep dive + Qs). Prefer later in the order if possible.
maria: I’m OOO Tue morning but free Wed. I’d ask for 10 min + 5 min Q, so 15 total.
lia: I can join — propose we timebox strictly. If someone needs more time, they should post a 5‑min Loom instead and we’ll slot them into the follow-up.
tanya: +1 to strict timeboxing. Also can we compact the agenda: group 2 short RFCs back-to-back to keep momentum?
megan: I’m happy to present, need 20 min. Will upload pre-read by EOD Mon. Can we put my slot first? I have a hard stop at 10:30 PT.
alex: Thanks all. Two asks:
  1) Please reply with a single number (10/15/20/30) so I can build the order quickly.
  2) Paste the pre-read link in this thread when ready.
Also: proposed compact agenda template (please copy/modify):
```
- 09:00 — quick housekeeping (2m)
- 09:02 — RFC A (presenter, 10m + 5m Q)
- 09:17 — RFC B (presenter, 20m + 5m Q)
- 09:42 — RFC C (presenter, 15m + 5m Q)
- 10:02 — action roundup & next steps (6m)
```
jamal: 25 -> I mean I'll stick with 20 if that helps ordering. Uploading pre-read now: https://drive/redwood/rfcs/jamal-embed-batching
maria: 15. Pre-read: https://drive/redwood/rfcs/maria-cache-coord (will add TL;DR at top)
lia: 10. No pre-read except a 1‑page summary I’ll paste in tomorrow.
tanya: 15, but happy to reduce to 10 if we need a slot swap.
megan: 20 and here’s the pre-read (slides): https://drive/redwood/rfcs/megan-kernel-selection
alex: OK — tentative order based on hard stops and lengths: megan (20, hard stop), jamal (20), maria (15), tanya (15), lia (10). That keeps two longer deep dives earlier.
alex: A couple of process notes:
- Pre-reads due by EOD Mon. If you miss that, you’re expected to add a 1‑paragraph summary in the thread before the meeting.
- We’ll enforce the agenda with a visible timer in the call. Hosts: alex + megan.
- If you can’t make, record a 5‑min Loom and post link; we’ll cover high-level bits and skip deep Qs.
megan: can we add a brief 2‑min rollout plan for any accepted RFCs at the end? I think that helps triage.
alex: yes — action roundup includes rollout ask. I'll put that in the calendar invite.
sre-bot: Reminder — meeting room reserved: infra-conf-2, dial-in and recording enabled.
jamal: small ask — can we put jamal’s RFC slides before megan? I can move if needed.
alex: jamal — you’re already after megan in the tentative order. I’ll swap if megan agrees.
megan: fine with jamal going first if jamal prefers. I still need my hard stop respected :) 
lia: tiny suggestion — add a label next to each agenda item for expected artifact type (slides, demo, design doc). Helps reviewers prep.
alex: good idea — I’ll update agenda template in the invite to include (slides/design doc/demo).
tanya: done — added a TL;DR tag to my pre-read here: https://drive/redwood/rfcs/tanya-rate-limiter
alex: Great. If no further changes, I’ll publish the final order by Tue noon and send reminders (pre-read + timebox). :thumbsup:
megan: thanks — will trim my deck to 10 slides.
jamal: +1 :thumbsup:
maria: thanks all — will post final pre-read summary by EOD.
alex: closed-loop: publish schedule by Tue 12:00 PT, pre-reads due Mon 23:59 PT, meeting Wed 09:00 PT. Thanks everyone.
